title.zh: 卷450 列傳二百三十七 李鹤年 文彬 任道镕 许振祎 吴大澂
title.en: Volume 450 Biographies 237: Li Henian, Wen Bin, Ren Daorong, Xu Zhenyi, Wu Dacheng
title.raw: 卷450 列傳二百三十七 李鹤年 文彬 任道镕 许振祎 吴大澂

sentences.zh: =李鶴年=李鶴年，字子和，奉天義州人。

translations.literal: Li Henian. Li Henian, courtesy name Zihe, was a native of Yizhou in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Henian, whose courtesy name was Zihe, came from Yizhou in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年進士，由編修改御史，轉給事中。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination; from compiler he was changed to censor, then transferred to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his jinshi degree in 1845, rose from compiler to censor, and was then appointed a supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，服除，命赴河南襄辦軍務。

translations.literal: He returned home on his father's mourning; when the mourning period ended, he was ordered to go to Henan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After returning home to observe mourning for his father, he was ordered back to Henan once the mourning period ended to help manage military affairs.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，授常鎮通海道，署河南按察使，調直隸，授布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was appointed Chang-Zhen-Tong-Hai circuit intendant, acted as Henan judicial commissioner, was transferred to Zhili, and appointed provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In 1862 he was made intendant of the Chang-Zhen-Tong-Hai circuit, served as acting judicial commissioner of Henan, transferred to Zhili, and received appointment as provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢湖北巡撫，調河南。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to governor of Hubei and transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he was promoted to governor of Hubei, then transferred to govern Henan.

sentences.zh: 時捻匪由山東南竄，鶴年以為十餘年來賊屢擾歸、陳、南、汝間，即去而他竄，必假道於豫。

translations.literal: At that time the Nian bandits fled south from Shandong; Henian believed that for more than ten years the bandits had repeatedly harassed the regions between Guide, Chen, Nan, and Ru, and that even when they left they would raid elsewhere and must pass through Yu.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels fled south from Shandong, Henian reasoned that for more than a decade they had repeatedly ravaged the lands between Guide, Chenzhou, Nanyang, and Ruzhou, and that whenever they moved on they would still have to cross Henan.

sentences.zh: 乃增募兩軍各萬餘人，一曰毅軍，宋慶統之；

translations.literal: He then additionally recruited two armies of more than ten thousand men each; one was called the Yijun, commanded by Song Qing;
translations.idiomatic: He raised two new forces of more than ten thousand men each: the Resolute Army under Song Qing;

sentences.zh: 一曰嵩武軍，張曜統之；

translations.literal: one was called the Songwujun, commanded by Zhang Yao;
translations.idiomatic: and the Songwu Army under Zhang Yao;

sentences.zh: 更以馬隊屬善慶，與兩軍為犄角。

translations.literal: He further placed cavalry under Shan Qing to form pincers with the two armies.
translations.idiomatic: He also assigned a cavalry detachment to Shan Qing to work in concert with the two infantry armies.

sentences.zh: 於是宋慶等軍大破張總愚睢州，鶴年親赴陳、留、杞督戰。

translations.literal: Thereupon Song Qing's army and others inflicted a great defeat on Zhang Zongyu at Suizhou; Henian personally went to Chen, Liu, and Qi to supervise the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qing's forces then routed Zhang Zongyu at Suizhou, while Henian went in person to Chenzhou, Kaifeng, and Qi County to direct operations.

sentences.zh: 任、賴各逆复乘虛北擾，鶴年以賊踪無定，防河尤急。

translations.literal: The rebels Ren and Lai again took advantage of a gap to raid north; Henian, because the bandits' tracks were uncertain, regarded defense of the river as especially urgent.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leaders Ren and Lai again slipped north to raid; with rebel movements unpredictable, Henian made defending the Yellow River his top priority.

sentences.zh: 賊果犯中牟，以有備不得逞，乃於省治西決堤引水南流，擾及長垣。

translations.literal: The bandits indeed attacked Zhongmou; because preparations had been made they could not succeed, so west of the provincial seat they breached the dike to draw water south, disturbing Changyuan as well.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels did strike Zhongmou, but found the defenses ready and could not break through; they then breached dikes west of the provincial capital to flood the country southward, spreading disorder as far as Changyuan.

sentences.zh: 鶴年飛檄水陸各軍沿堤剿堵。

translations.literal: Henian sent urgent dispatches to land and water forces along the dike to pursue and block.
translations.idiomatic: Henian urgently ordered every land and river unit along the embankments to pursue and seal off the rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊西走湖北麻城、黃岡，詔飭宋慶一軍越境會剿，殲賊無算。

translations.literal: The bandits fled west to Macheng and Huanggang in Hubei; an edict ordered Song Qing's army to cross the border for joint suppression, destroying countless bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled west into Macheng and Huanggang in Hubei; the court ordered Song Qing's army across the border for a joint campaign that killed rebels beyond count.

sentences.zh: 鶴年自駐許州策應，賊竄裕州，慶擊敗之。

translations.literal: Henian himself stationed at Xuzhou to coordinate support; the bandits fled to Yuzhou and Qing defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Henian held Xuzhou to coordinate the campaign; when the rebels slipped into Yuzhou, Song Qing drove them back.

sentences.zh: 善慶及淮軍劉銘傳大敗賊贛榆，任柱被戕死。

translations.literal: Shan Qing and Liu Mingchuan of the Huai Army inflicted a great defeat on the bandits at Ganyu; Ren Zhu was killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Qing and Liu Mingchuan of the Huai Army routed the rebels at Ganyu, where Ren Zhu was slain.

sentences.zh: 賜鶴年頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: Henian was granted the first-rank official's cap button.
translations.idiomatic: Henian was awarded the first-rank official cap button.

sentences.zh: 七年，奉命督師出境，馳抵磁州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to command troops beyond the border and hastened to Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1868 he was ordered to lead troops outside the province and rode at once to Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 捻犯近畿，更由滑、濬等處沿河東趨。

translations.literal: The Nian invaded the metropolitan vicinity and further advanced east along the river through Hua and Jun and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian struck the capital region and pressed east along the river through Hua and Jun.

sentences.zh: 坐防堵不力，再議處。

translations.literal: He was punished for ineffective defense and blocking; penalties were again deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: He was censured again for failing to hold the line, and further penalties were considered.

sentences.zh: 豫軍告捷，賞還頂戴。

translations.literal: The Henan army reported victory, and his cap button was returned as a reward.
translations.idiomatic: When Henan forces reported victory, his cap button was restored as a reward.

sentences.zh: 總愚溺死，捻匪平，照一等軍功議敘。

translations.literal: Zongyu drowned; the Nian bandits were pacified, and rewards were deliberated according to first-class military merit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu drowned, the Nian rebellion was crushed, and Henian's service was rated for first-class military honors.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 明年，陛見，賜紫禁城騎馬。

translations.literal: The next year he had an audience and was granted the privilege of riding a horse in the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was received in audience and granted the rare honor of riding a horse inside the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 旋署福州將軍，兼署巡撫。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he acted as Fuzhou general and concurrently acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting Fuzhou general while also acting as governor.

sentences.zh: 詔詢海防事宜，覆奏言：「海防之策，莫重於練兵、籌餉、制器、用人四端。

translations.literal: The throne inquired about coastal defense; in reply he memorialized: "In coastal defense policy, nothing is more important than the four points of training troops, securing funds, manufacturing weapons, and employing men."
translations.idiomatic: When the court asked about coastal defense, he replied in a memorial: "Coastal defense rests above all on four pillars: training troops, securing funds, manufacturing arms, and appointing the right men."

sentences.zh: 四者之中，以用人為急務，而尤在專其責成。

translations.literal: Among the four, employing men is the urgent task, and especially in fixing clear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Of the four, personnel is the most urgent, especially when each post carries clear, exclusive responsibility.

sentences.zh: 沿海疆臣固責無旁貸，第無統率大員，仍恐意見紛歧，臨事推諉。

translations.literal: Coastal frontier officials certainly cannot shirk responsibility, but without a supervising high official there is still fear of divided opinions and shifting blame when matters arise.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier governors along the coast cannot evade duty, yet without a single commander-in-chief, opinions will split and officials will pass the buck when crises come.

sentences.zh: 」上韙其議。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor endorsed his view.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，調河東河道總督，兼署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was transferred to director-general of the Hedong Yellow River conservancy and concurrently acted as governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he was made director-general of the Hedong Yellow River works while also acting as governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 七年，授河南巡撫，仍兼河督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed governor of Henan while still holding the river directorship.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881 he received appointment as governor of Henan while retaining the river commission.

sentences.zh: 十年，坐審辦盜犯胡體安連疏抗辨，部議革職，以祝嘏恩賞降二級職銜。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was punished for repeatedly memorializing in defense while trying the bandit Hu Ti'an; the ministry deliberated dismissal, but because of birthday felicitations he was rewarded with reduction by two ranks in title only.
translations.idiomatic: In 1884 he was faulted for defying the court with repeated memorials while trying the outlaw Hu Ti'an; the ministry recommended dismissal, but an imperial birthday amnesty reduced the penalty to a two-rank demotion in title.

sentences.zh: 十三年，署河督，疏言：「黃河分流，自宋時河決澶州，分為二派。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he acted as river director and memorialized: "The Yellow River divided its flow; since the Song, when the river broke at Dazhou, it split into two branches."
translations.idiomatic: In 1887, serving again as river director, he wrote: "The Yellow River has long run in divided channels; since the Song breach at Dazhou it split into two courses."

sentences.zh: 明築黃陵岡，始合為一。

translations.literal: In the Ming, when Huangling Hill was built up, it first became one again.
translations.idiomatic: Only when the Ming built up Huangling Hill did the streams reunite into one channel.

sentences.zh: 河性上漫則下淤，今兩路皆淤，急宜疏支河以預籌宣洩。

translations.literal: The river's nature is that when the upper course overflows the lower silts; now both routes are silted and branch rivers should urgently be dredged to plan discharge in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The river silts below whenever it floods above; with both courses now choked, branch channels must be opened at once to provide outlets for floodwater.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 逾年，鄭工復決，發軍台效力。

translations.literal: The next year the Zhengzhou works broke again; he was sent to serve penance at the military penal station.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Zhengzhou embankment failed again, and he was sent to labor at a military penal station.

sentences.zh: 未幾釋歸，並賞三品銜。

translations.literal: Before long he was released to return home and was also granted third-rank title.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was released to return home and was granted a third-rank honorary title.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1890.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，開復原官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong his original office was restored posthumously.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 his original rank was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 鶴年有知人鑑，少與文祥同學相淬厲。

translations.literal: Henian had discernment in judging men; in youth he studied with Wen Xiang and they spurred each other on.
translations.idiomatic: Henian had a keen eye for talent; as a young man he studied alongside Wen Xiang, and the two sharpened each other.

sentences.zh: 及居言職，嚴疏劾肅順跋扈，而奏起曾國籓於家，謂必能辦賊。

translations.literal: When he held a remonstrating post he sternly memorialized against Sushun's arrogance, and memorialized to recall Zeng Guofan from home, saying he would surely be able to handle the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In his censorial posts he fiercely impeached Sushun for arrogance and urged the court to recall Zeng Guofan from retirement, insisting that Zeng alone could defeat the rebels.

sentences.zh: 拔宋慶、張曜統豫軍，後皆為名將。

translations.literal: He promoted Song Qing and Zhang Yao to command the Henan armies; both later became famous generals.
translations.idiomatic: He elevated Song Qing and Zhang Yao to lead Henan forces, and both later became celebrated generals.

sentences.zh: 治豫久，多善政，豫人刻石頌之。

translations.literal: He governed Henan for a long time with many good policies; the people of Yu carved stone to praise him.
translations.idiomatic: After long service in Henan with many sound policies, the people set up stone inscriptions in his praise.

sentences.zh: 始任河督，黑岡堤潰，不絕如縷。

translations.literal: When he first took the river directorship, the Heigang dike burst and hung by a thread.
translations.idiomatic: When he first became river director, the Heigang embankment was breached and barely held together.

sentences.zh: 鶴年親督工二十餘晝夜，險工克濟。

translations.literal: Henian personally supervised the work for more than twenty days and nights, and the critical works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: Henian personally oversaw the repairs for more than twenty days and nights until the most dangerous section was secured.

sentences.zh: 德宗嘗詢李鴻藻以善治河者，鴻藻舉鶴年，上亦識前事之枉也，故再任河督。

translations.literal: The Dezong Emperor once asked Li Hongzao who was good at governing the river; Hongzao recommended Henian; the emperor also recognized that the earlier matter had been unjust, and therefore appointed him river director again.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangxu once asked Li Hongzao who best managed the Yellow River; Hongzao named Henian, and the emperor, recognizing the injustice of his earlier dismissal, appointed him river director a second time.

sentences.zh: 其卒也，豫民有流涕者。

translations.literal: At his death there were people of Yu who wept.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, some Henan commoners wept openly.

sentences.zh: 三子葆恂博學多文，尤知名。

translations.literal: His third son Baoxun was erudite and literary and especially well known.
translations.idiomatic: His third son Baoxun was a learned and prolific writer who became especially famous.

sentences.zh: =文彬=文彬，字質夫，納喇氏，內務府滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Bin. Wen Bin, courtesy name Zhifu, of the Nara clan, was a Bannerman of the Imperial Household Department's Manchu Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Bin, whose courtesy name was Zhifu, belonged to the Nara clan and came from the Manchu Plain White Banner of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年進士，授戶部主事。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the second year of Xianfeng; appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in 1852 and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十年，以員外郎隨扈幸熱河。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, as vice director he accompanied the imperial progress to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In 1860, as a vice director, he accompanied the court to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷郎中，出知山東沂州府。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to director and went out to govern Yizhou prefecture in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to director and sent out to govern Yizhou in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 捻匪逼府城，會師攻拔賊巢，擒匪首孫化詳等。

translations.literal: Nian bandits pressed the prefectural city; he joined forces to attack and capture the bandit lair, seizing the bandit chiefs Sun Huaxiang and others.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels threatened the prefectural seat, he combined forces, stormed their stronghold, and captured the chieftain Sun Huaxiang and others.

sentences.zh: 敘功，以道員用。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded and he was used at the rank of circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: For this service he was recommended for appointment as a circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，隨布政使丁寶楨敗賊滕縣臨城驛，更繞赴東平防賊北竄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he followed provincial treasurer Ding Baozhen in defeating bandits at Lincheng Post in Teng County, then circled to Dongping to guard against the bandits' northward flight.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he fought with Provincial Treasurer Ding Baozhen to defeat rebels at Lincheng Post in Teng County, then swung to Dongping to block a northward rebel breakout.

sentences.zh: 補兗沂曹濟道，擢按察使。

translations.literal: He was appointed to the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit and promoted to judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit and promoted to judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 收復海豐，擢布政使。

translations.literal: He recovered Haifeng and was promoted to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: After recovering Haifeng he was promoted to provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十年，署巡撫，補漕運總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as governor and was appointed director-general of grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he served as acting governor and was appointed director-general of grain transport.

sentences.zh: 再署巡撫，旋還任。

translations.literal: He again acted as governor, then soon returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as acting governor before returning to his regular post.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，督漕北上，因請陛見，並與河督李鶴年、巡撫週恆祺會商運河事宜，通籌河道寬深，改設運口，導引衛河，設立堤壩，繪具圖說以進。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu he supervised grain transport northward, requested an audience, and together with river director Li Henian and Governor Zhou Hengqi consulted on Grand Canal affairs, comprehensively planning channel width and depth, changing transport mouths, diverting the Wei River, establishing dikes and dams, and submitting illustrated plans.
translations.idiomatic: In 1879, while escorting the grain fleet north, he sought an audience and met with River Director Li Henian and Governor Zhou Hengqi to plan the Grand Canal: widening and deepening the channel, relocating transport mouths, tapping the Wei River, building dikes and barrages, and submitting illustrated proposals.

sentences.zh: 略謂：「現時北運口在張秋南八里廟，與南運口斜對，相距二十餘裡。

translations.literal: He stated in summary: "At present the northern transport mouth is at Balimiao south of Zhangqiu, obliquely opposite the southern transport mouth, more than twenty li apart."
translations.idiomatic: He argued in brief: "Today the northern transport mouth lies at Balimiao south of Zhangqiu, set obliquely opposite the southern mouth some twenty li away."

sentences.zh: 黃流至此雖收束，而溜勢散漫，歧汊甚多。

translations.literal: Although the Yellow current is somewhat confined here, the flow is scattered and there are many branch channels.
translations.idiomatic: Although the Yellow River narrows here, the current spreads wide with many side channels.

sentences.zh: 大抵溜勢近南則北口淤墊，近北則南口淺阻。

translations.literal: Generally when the current lies toward the south the northern mouth silts up, and when it lies toward the north the southern mouth becomes shallow and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: As a rule, when the current shifts south the northern mouth silts up; when it shifts north the southern mouth shoals and blocks.

sentences.zh: 故漕船出南運口入黃後，必東北行二十里，至黃溜匯一之史家橋，再南行二十里，至八里廟北運口，汛水大漲，方能入運。

translations.literal: Therefore after grain boats leave the southern transport mouth and enter the Yellow River they must go northeast twenty li to Shijia Bridge where the Yellow current converges, then south another twenty li to the northern transport mouth at Balimiao; only when flood waters rise greatly can they enter the canal.
translations.idiomatic: Grain boats leaving the southern mouth must therefore sail twenty li northeast to Shijia Bridge, where the Yellow current gathers, then twenty li south to the northern mouth at Balimiao—and only when flood season swells the river can they enter the canal.

sentences.zh: 今擬移北運口於史家橋北六里。

translations.literal: It is now proposed to move the northern transport mouth six li north of Shijia Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed moving the northern transport mouth six li north of Shijia Bridge.

sentences.zh: 黃河西岸，由阿城徬東堤開河一道至陶長堡，為出黃入運口門，築壩灌塘，則黃水不至奪溜，可免牽挽之難。

translations.literal: On the west bank of the Yellow River, from Acheng along the east dike a channel is to be opened to Taochang Fort as the mouth for leaving the Yellow and entering the canal; building dams and irrigation ponds will keep Yellow water from seizing the current and avoid the hardship of towing.
translations.idiomatic: On the west bank, a channel would be cut from Acheng along the eastern dike to Taochang Fort as the Yellow-to-canal outlet; with dams and storage ponds, Yellow River water would not seize the current and boats could avoid arduous towing.

sentences.zh: 黃、運之間，自賈工合龍後，每伏秋大雨，水無所洩，民間低地有積水數年不得耕種者，若將陂水引歸一塘，不惟蓄水濟運，又可涸复民田。

translations.literal: Between the Yellow and the canal, since the Jia works were joined, every summer and autumn heavy rain has had nowhere to drain; in low places among the people water has stood for years without cultivation. If pond water is led back into one reservoir, it will not only store water to aid transport but also drain and restore farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Yellow River and the canal, ever since the Jia embankment closure, summer and autumn floods have had no outlet; lowlands have stood under water for years. Channeling these waters into a single reservoir would store water for transport while draining fields back into cultivation.

sentences.zh: 運口既定，即可導引衛河。

translations.literal: Once the transport mouth is fixed, the Wei River can be diverted.
translations.idiomatic: Once the transport mouth was fixed, the Wei River could be tapped.

sentences.zh: 自直隸元城集東三里衛河曲處鑿新河一道，經直隸之南樂、山東之朝城，至張秋南之蕭口涵洞入運。

translations.literal: From three li east of Yuancheng Market in Zhili, at a bend of the Wei River, a new channel is to be cut through Nanle in Zhili and Chaocheng in Shandong to the Xiaokou culvert south of Zhangqiu entering the canal.
translations.idiomatic: A new canal would be cut three li east of Yuancheng Market in Zhili, where the Wei bends, running through Nanle in Zhili and Chaocheng in Shandong to enter the Grand Canal at the Xiaokou culvert south of Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 計衛高於運九丈餘，長百五十餘裡，導以濟運，勢如建瓴。

translations.literal: The Wei is calculated to stand more than nine zhang above the canal, over one hundred fifty li in length; diverted to aid transport, the force would be like water poured from a high eave.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei stands more than nine zhang above the canal along a course of over 150 li; directed into the transport system, its force would pour down like water from a rooftop.

sentences.zh: 更有大小二丹水，亦可由衛濟運。

translations.literal: Moreover the greater and lesser Dan waters can also aid transport through the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The greater and lesser Dan streams could likewise feed the canal through the Wei.

sentences.zh: 凡建四徬二壩及挑河築堤，估銀七十六萬。

translations.literal: In all, building four embankments, two dams, dredging rivers and constructing dikes is estimated at 760,000 taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Building four embankments, two dams, dredging, and dike work was estimated at 760,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 較之借黃濟運旋挑旋淤者，相去遠矣。

translations.literal: Compared with borrowing the Yellow to aid transport, where dredging is immediately followed by silting, the difference is vast.
translations.idiomatic: This was far preferable to relying on the Yellow River for transport, where dredging was undone as quickly as it was done.

sentences.zh: 又嘗偕兩江總督吳元炳奏复淮流故道，略謂：「淮水匯四十餘河瀦於洪澤湖，楊莊以下云梯關為入海故道，餘波入運濟漕。

translations.literal: He also once joined Governor-General Wu Yuanbing of the Two Jiangs in memorializing to restore the Huai River's old course, stating in summary: "The Huai gathers more than forty rivers and pools in Hongze Lake; below Yangzhuang, Yunti Pass is the old course to the sea, and the remaining waves enter the canal to aid grain transport."
translations.idiomatic: He also joined Two Jiangs Governor-General Wu Yuanbing in urging restoration of the Huai's old channel, arguing: "More than forty rivers feed the Huai into Hongze Lake; below Yangzhuang, Yunti Pass was its historic outlet to the sea, while surplus water entered the canal for grain transport."

sentences.zh: 遇旱，复蓄淮流由運河分入淮揚各徬洞，以溉民田。

translations.literal: In drought, Huai water was again stored and divided from the canal into the various sluices of Huai and Yang to irrigate farmland.
translations.idiomatic: In drought years, stored Huai water was distributed through canal sluices across the Huai-Yang region to irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 自洪澤湖不能瀦水，張、福引河又不通暢，每遇盛漲，運河一線東堤，其勢岌岌。

translations.literal: Since Hongze Lake can no longer hold water and the Zhang and Fu diversion rivers are not unobstructed, whenever floods swell the canal's single-line eastern dike is in perilous condition.
translations.idiomatic: Since Hongze Lake no longer holds water and the Zhang and Fu diversion channels are choked, every major flood leaves the canal's narrow eastern dike in grave danger.

sentences.zh: 儻竟衝溢，不至以里下河為壑不止。

translations.literal: If it should finally burst and overflow, it would not stop until making the Lixia River region a ravine.
translations.idiomatic: If the dike gave way, the flood would not stop until the Lixia River lowlands were drowned.

sentences.zh: 論者謂必設法束水，然與其上游議堵，何如下游深通。

translations.literal: Discussants say water must be constrained by some method, but rather than debating blockage upstream, how much better to dredge deeply downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that the waters must be confined, but rather than blocking the upper reaches, deep dredging downstream was the better course.

sentences.zh: 」因條上疏濬楊莊以下舊河入海故道。

translations.literal: " He therefore itemized a memorial to dredge the old river course below Yangzhuang to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore submitted a detailed plan to dredge the old outlet below Yangzhuang to the sea.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，有詔褒錫。

translations.literal: Before long he died; an edict bestowed posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward, and the court issued posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督劉坤一以文彬遺愛在民，請建專祠清江浦，允之。

translations.literal: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs, because Wen Bin's lingering affection remained among the people, requested a dedicated shrine at Qingjiangpu; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Two Jiangs Governor-General Liu Kunyi, citing the people's enduring affection for Wen Bin, asked to build him a shrine at Qingjiangpu, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 子延煜，舉人，四川鹽茶道；

translations.literal: His son Yanyu, a provincial graduate, was salt transport intendant of Sichuan;
translations.idiomatic: His son Yanyu, a provincial graduate, served as Sichuan salt transport intendant;

sentences.zh: 延熙，舉人，九江知府；

translations.literal: Yanxi, a provincial graduate, was prefect of Jiujiang;
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi, a provincial graduate, was prefect of Jiujiang;

sentences.zh: 延燮，進士，武昌知縣；

translations.literal: Yanshu, a jinshi, was magistrate of Wuchang;
translations.idiomatic: Yanshu, a jinshi, was magistrate of Wuchang;

sentences.zh: 延照，舉人，禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Yanzhao, a provincial graduate, was vice director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhao, a provincial graduate, was a vice director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: =任道鎔=任道鎔，字筱沅，江蘇宜興人。

translations.literal: Ren Daorong. Ren Daorong, courtesy name Xiaoyuan, was a native of Yixing in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Daorong, whose courtesy name was Xiaoyuan, came from Yixing in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，考授教職。

translations.literal: A selected tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed to an educational post.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a tribute student, he passed the examination and received an educational appointment.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，在籍襄辦團練，除奉賢訓導。

translations.literal: During Xianfeng, while at home he assisted in organizing militia training and was appointed Fengxian instructor.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era he helped organize local militia while at home and was appointed instructor at Fengxian.

sentences.zh: 以籌餉勞，晉秩知縣，銓當陽，多善政，調江夏。

translations.literal: For labor in raising funds he was advanced to magistrate rank, was selected for Dangyang with many good policies, and was transferred to Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: For his work raising funds he was promoted to magistrate, assigned to Dangyang where he earned a reputation for sound governance, then transferred to Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，擢知順德府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he was promoted to govern Shunde prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1863 he was promoted to prefect of Shunde.

sentences.zh: 畿南匪起，行堅壁清野法，修治城堡，屢擊賊於沙河、平鄉間。

translations.literal: Bandits rose south of the capital region; he carried out the policy of strengthening walls and clearing the countryside, repaired castles, and repeatedly struck bandits between Shahe and Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose south of the capital region, he enforced fortified villages and scorched-earth tactics, repaired fortifications, and repeatedly defeated rebels between Shahe and Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 會捻眾北犯，道鎔率練勇守沙河。

translations.literal: When Nian masses invaded north, Daorong led militia to defend Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian forces pushed north, Daorong led local militia to hold Shahe.

sentences.zh: 夜與賊遇，揮眾奮擊，矛傷及身，不退，賊徐引去，晉秩道員。

translations.literal: At night he met the bandits, waved the crowd to strike fiercely, was wounded by a spear but did not retreat; the bandits slowly withdrew, and he was advanced to circuit intendant rank.
translations.idiomatic: He met the rebels by night, led a fierce charge, took a spear wound yet held his ground until the enemy withdrew; he was then promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 洺河自廣平入，久淤塞。

translations.literal: The Ming River enters from Guangping and had long been silted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming River, entering from Guangping, had long been choked with silt.

sentences.zh: 道鎔與鄰郡合濬，又濬郡北響水河，复民田萬餘頃。

translations.literal: Daorong joined neighboring prefectures in dredging, and also dredged the Xiangshui River north of the prefecture, restoring more than ten thousand qing of farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong worked with neighboring prefectures to dredge it and also cleared the Xiangshui River north of the prefecture, restoring more than ten thousand qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 總督曾國籓、李鴻章迭薦之。

translations.literal: Governors-general Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang repeatedly recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang recommended him repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調保定，尋擢開歸陳許道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Baoding, and soon promoted to the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1872 he was transferred to Baoding and soon promoted to intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit.

sentences.zh: 剔河工積弊，驗工料必以實。

translations.literal: He eliminated long-standing abuses in river works and verified materials and labor strictly according to fact.
translations.idiomatic: He rooted out entrenched abuses in river works and insisted on verifying labor and materials on the ground.

sentences.zh: 嘗冒風雨搶護中河險工，四晝夜始定。

translations.literal: Once he braved wind and rain to rush to protect the critical works on the middle river; only after four days and nights was it stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: He once worked through wind and rain to shore up a critical breach in the middle reach of the river, and the site was not secured until four days and nights had passed.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，署按察使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he acted as judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he served as acting judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 授江西按察使，省獄羈囚四百餘人，道鎔便宜訊決，三月而清。

translations.literal: He was appointed judicial commissioner of Jiangxi; there were more than four hundred detainees in the provincial prison; Daorong used discretionary authority to try and decide cases, and within three months they were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed judicial commissioner of Jiangxi, he found more than four hundred prisoners held in the provincial jail; Daorong exercised discretionary authority to hear and decide the cases, and within three months the backlog was cleared.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷浙江布政使，調直隸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to provincial treasurer of Zhejiang, then transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In 1878 he became provincial treasurer of Zhejiang and was then transferred to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 直隸自軍興，州縣報銷未清，又數值謁陵大差，交代糾葛。

translations.literal: Since the military upheavals in Zhili, county and prefectural expense accounts had not been cleared, and there had repeatedly been great assignments for tomb attendance, causing entanglements in handovers.
translations.idiomatic: Since the rebellions, Zhili's counties and prefectures had left expense accounts unsettled, and repeated imperial tomb missions had tangled every handover of office.

sentences.zh: 道鎔分別新舊案，定限清結。

translations.literal: Daorong distinguished new and old cases and set deadlines for clearing them.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong sorted old cases from new and set firm deadlines to settle them.

sentences.zh: 裁革州縣攤捐，實發養廉銀以卹吏，勸屬縣積穀備荒。

translations.literal: He abolished county and prefectural apportioned levies, actually disbursed integrity-nourishment silver to support clerks, and urged subordinate counties to store grain against famine.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished apportioned levies at the county and prefectural level, paid integrity allowances to support local clerks, and urged subordinate counties to store grain against famine.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢山東巡撫，疏陳營務廢弛，易置統將，以綠營額餉練新軍，責郡縣勤緝捕。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to governor of Shandong; in a memorial he stated that military affairs had grown lax, replaced commanding generals, used Green Standard quota stipends to train new troops, and charged prefectures and counties with diligent pursuit and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881 he was promoted to governor of Shandong; in a memorial he reported that military discipline had slipped, replaced commanding generals, used Green Standard stipends to train new forces, and ordered prefectures and counties to step up pursuit and arrest.

sentences.zh: 泰山、沂水之間，驛路崎嶇，發卒開治平坦，行旅便之。

translations.literal: Between Mount Tai and the Yi River the post road was rugged; he dispatched laborers to open and level it, to the convenience of travelers.
translations.idiomatic: Between Mount Tai and the Yi River the courier road was rough; he sent workers to level the route, greatly easing travel.

sentences.zh: 旋以保獎已革知府潘駿群被議，又以失察編修林國柱預報起復，被劾褫職，降道員。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was criticized for having commended the already dismissed prefect Pan Junqun, and also for failure to detect compiler Lin Guozhu's advance notice of recall to office; he was impeached, stripped of office, and reduced to circuit intendant rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was censured for recommending the already dismissed prefect Pan Junqun and for failing to detect that compiler Lin Guozhu had been tipped off about his recall; impeached and stripped of office, he was demoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 家居久之。

translations.literal: He remained at home for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in retirement for many years.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，起河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was recalled as director-general of river conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he was recalled to serve as director-general of river conservancy.

sentences.zh: 故事，河督，開封、濟寧並設行署。

translations.literal: By precedent, the river director had branch offices established at both Kaifeng and Jining.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, the river director maintained branch offices at both Kaifeng and Jining.

sentences.zh: 自咸豐時，常駐開封，山東河事由巡撫專治。

translations.literal: Since the Xianfeng era he had usually resided at Kaifeng, and Shandong river affairs were managed exclusively by the governor.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Xianfeng era the director had usually remained at Kaifeng while the governor of Shandong managed that province's river works alone.

sentences.zh: 至是復改議河督駐濟寧，而河南巡撫兼治河。

translations.literal: At this time it was again proposed that the river director should reside at Jining while the governor of Henan would concurrently manage the river.
translations.idiomatic: Now the court again proposed stationing the river director at Jining and putting Henan's governor in charge of river affairs there.

sentences.zh: 道鎔言：「官吏不相屬，則令難行，不如仍舊便。

translations.literal: Daorong said: "If officials do not answer to one another, orders are hard to carry out; it is better to keep the old arrangement."
translations.idiomatic: Daorong argued: "When officials do not answer to one another, orders are hard to enforce; it is better to keep the old arrangement."

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 時河患多在下游，河督專司上游，事簡。

translations.literal: At the time river troubles lay mostly downstream; the river director handled only the upper reaches, and duties were lighter.
translations.idiomatic: River troubles then lay mostly downstream, so the director's charge of the upper reaches was comparatively light.

sentences.zh: 道鎔務節費，歲以餘帑還司庫。

translations.literal: Daorong worked to economize and each year returned surplus funds to the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong practiced strict economy and each year returned surplus funds to the provincial treasury.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪起，河南奸民乘機煽亂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer bandits rose, and ruffians in Henan took the opportunity to stir rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900 the Boxers rose, and ruffians in Henan took the opportunity to stir up disorder.

sentences.zh: 道鎔處以鎮靜，練河標三營助省防。

translations.literal: Daorong responded with calm and drilled three battalions of river troops to aid provincial defense.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong kept his province calm and drilled three battalions of river troops to reinforce provincial defenses.

sentences.zh: 次年，調浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 承國威新挫後，民教相閧，案多未結，持平訊決之。

translations.literal: Following the recent blow to national prestige, commoners and Christians clashed with one another and many cases remained unsettled; he heard and decided them with impartial balance.
translations.idiomatic: After the recent blow to national prestige, conflicts between commoners and Christians abounded and many cases remained open; he heard and decided them with impartial balance.

sentences.zh: 籌集償款，衡其緩急，民不重困。

translations.literal: He raised indemnity funds and weighed urgency so the people would not be doubly burdened.
translations.idiomatic: He raised indemnity funds and weighed each claim's urgency so the people would not be crushed under a second burden.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，乞病歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he requested leave for illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In 1902 he requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 逾三年，卒於家，年八十三。

translations.literal: More than three years later he died at home, aged eighty-three.
translations.idiomatic: More than three years later he died at home, aged eighty-three.

sentences.zh: =許振禕=許振禕，字仙屏，江西奉新人。

translations.literal: Xu Zhenyi. Xu Zhenyi, courtesy name Xianping, was a native of Fengxin in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhenyi, whose courtesy name was Xianping, came from Fengxin in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，以拔貢生參曾國籓戎幕。

translations.literal: Early in Xianfeng, as a selected tribute student he joined Zeng Guofan's military staff.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianfeng era, as a selected tribute student he joined Zeng Guofan's military staff.

sentences.zh: 迨楚軍困於江西，都邑相繼陷，振禕偕內閣中書鄧輔綸募鄉兵擊賊進賢、東鄉，旋复吉安。

translations.literal: When the Hunan Army was trapped in Jiangxi and cities fell in succession, Zhenyi together with Secretariat Drafter Deng Fulun raised militia to strike bandits in Jinxian and Dongxiang, then soon recovered Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hunan Army was trapped in Jiangxi and city after city fell, Zhenyi joined Secretariat Drafter Deng Fulun in raising local militia to attack rebels in Jinxian and Dongxiang, and soon recovered Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 敘功，以同知銓選。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded and he was selected for appointment as subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: For this service he was recommended for appointment as a subprefect.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，成進士，授職編修，出督陝甘學政。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he passed the jinshi examination, received appointment as compiler, and went out to serve as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1863 he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a compiler, and was sent out as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 時河州降回复叛，而西寧諸郡回、漢民亦日相仇殺，試事久停不舉。

translations.literal: At the time the surrendered Muslims of Hezhou rebelled again, and in the prefectures around Xining Muslims and Han commoners daily killed one another in feud; examinations had long been suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered Muslims of Hezhou had rebelled again, and in the prefectures around Xining Muslims and Han commoners were killing one another daily; examinations had long been suspended.

sentences.zh: 振禕始按試各郡，多錄降人子弟，補行八次歲科試，入學者數千人，回民大服。

translations.literal: Zhenyi began conducting examinations in each prefecture, enrolled many sons and younger brothers of surrendered peoples, made up eight years of annual county examinations, and thousands entered schools; the Muslim people were greatly won over.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyi began holding examinations in each prefecture, enrolled many sons of the surrendered peoples, made up eight years of missed county examinations, and thousands entered school; the Muslim communities were deeply impressed.

sentences.zh: 建味經書院於涇陽，廣置書籍，以化其獷俗。

translations.literal: He built the Weijing Academy at Jingyang, broadly furnished books, to transform their unruly customs.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Weijing Academy at Jingyang and stocked it with books to soften the region's rough frontier ways.

sentences.zh: 又請陝、甘分闈鄉試，各設學政，允之。

translations.literal: He also requested separate provincial examination venues for Shaanxi and Gansu, each with its own educational commissioner; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also petitioned for separate provincial examination venues in Shaanxi and Gansu, each with its own educational commissioner, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 總督左宗棠以謂邊氓長治久安之效，胥基於此。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zuo Zongtang held that the effect of long-term peace among frontier peoples would all be rooted in this.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zuo Zongtang held that lasting peace on the frontier would all rest on measures such as these.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸。

translations.literal: He returned home on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，起故官。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was recalled to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1876 he was recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 八年，授彰衛懷道，減屬縣差徭費歲二十餘萬。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed to the Zhang-Wei-Huai circuit and reduced corvée and miscellaneous fees in subordinate counties by more than two hundred thousand taels per year.
translations.idiomatic: In 1882 he was appointed intendant of the Zhang-Wei-Huai circuit and cut corvée and miscellaneous fees in subordinate counties by more than two hundred thousand taels a year.

sentences.zh: 豫修里河堤防，淮海各鹽區得免水患。

translations.literal: He preemptively repaired inner-river dikes and embankments, and the various salt districts of Huai and Hai were spared water disasters.
translations.idiomatic: By repairing inner-river dikes in advance, he spared the salt districts of the Huai and Hai regions from flood damage.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擢河東河道總督，築滎澤大壩，胡家屯、米童寨各石壩，河賴以無患。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to director-general of the Hedong Yellow River conservancy; he built the great dam at Xingze and stone dams at Hujiatun and Mitongzhai, and the river thereby avoided trouble.
translations.idiomatic: In 1890 he was promoted to director-general of the Hedong Yellow River works; he built the great dam at Xingze and stone barrages at Hujiatun and Mitongzhai, and the river remained free of major trouble.

sentences.zh: 其要尤在嚴稽察，不私財權，令七廳徑赴司庫支領，故積弊徐而工堅。

translations.literal: The key especially lay in strict audit, not privatizing financial authority; he ordered the seven bureaus to draw funds directly from the treasury, and thus long-standing abuses were slowly eliminated and the works were solid.
translations.idiomatic: Above all he enforced strict audits and kept financial authority out of private hands, requiring the seven bureaus to draw funds directly from the treasury; long-standing abuses faded and the works grew solid.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，遷廣東巡撫，禁賭闈姓，粵民利賴之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to governor of Guangdong; he banned gambling on surname lists in the examination enclosure, and the people of Guangdong benefited.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he was transferred to governor of Guangdong; he banned gambling on examination surname lists, to the great benefit of the people of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，裁廣東、雲南、湖北三巡撫缺，振禕調內用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the governorships of Guangdong, Yunnan, and Hubei were abolished; Zhenyi was transferred to central appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 the governorships of Guangdong, Yunnan, and Hubei were abolished, and Zhenyi was transferred to a central appointment.

sentences.zh: 乞假歸，逾年卒。

translations.literal: He requested leave and returned home; the next year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He requested leave and returned home; the following year he died.

sentences.zh: 附祀江蘇、河南曾國籓祠。

translations.literal: He was enshrined alongside Zeng Guofan in temples in Jiangsu and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was given a place of honor in Zeng Guofan's memorial temples in Jiangsu and Henan.

sentences.zh: =吳大澂=吳大澂，字清卿，江蘇吳縣人。

translations.literal: Wu Dacheng. Wu Dacheng, courtesy name Qingqing, was a native of Wu County in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dacheng, whose courtesy name was Qingqing, came from Wu County in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年秋，彗星見西北，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In autumn of the first year of Tongzhi a comet appeared in the northwest, and an edict sought forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of 1862 a comet appeared in the northwest, and the throne issued an edict calling for frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 大澂方為諸生，入都應京兆試。

translations.literal: Dacheng was then a commoner scholar and entered the capital to take the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng was then a commoner scholar and had come to the capital to sit for the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 上書言：「致治之本，在興儉舉廉，不言理財而財自裕。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial stating: "The root of good government lies in promoting frugality and recommending integrity; without speaking of managing finances, finances will of themselves become ample.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial arguing: "The foundation of good government lies in promoting frugality and elevating the upright; speak nothing of finance, and the treasury will fill of its own accord.

sentences.zh: 若專務掊克，罔恤民艱，其國必敝。

translations.literal: If one devotes oneself solely to extortion without regard for the people's hardship, the state must decline."
translations.idiomatic: If a ruler devotes himself solely to squeezing the people and ignores their hardship, the state must fall into ruin."

sentences.zh: 」後六年成進士，授編修。

translations.literal: " Six years later he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: " Six years later he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 穆宗大婚典禮隆縟，疏請裁減繁費，直聲震朝右。

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong's wedding ceremonies were lavish and elaborate, he memorialized to cut redundant expenses; his forthright reputation shook the court.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Tongzhi's wedding ceremonies grew lavish beyond measure, he memorialized to cut redundant expenses, and his blunt honesty shook the court.

sentences.zh: 出為陝甘學政，奏以倉頡列祀典，允之。

translations.literal: Sent out as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu, he memorialized to place Cangjie in the sacrificial canon; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu, he memorialized to add Cangjie, legendary inventor of writing, to the state sacrificial canon, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 又薦諸生賀瑞麟、楊樹椿篤志正學，給瑞麟國子監學正銜，樹椿翰林院待詔銜，士風為之一變。

translations.literal: He also recommended commoner scholars He Ruilin and Yang Shuchun, men of earnest purpose and upright learning; Ruilin was given the title of director of study at the Imperial Academy, and Shuchun the title of Hanlin awaiting edict; scholarly custom was thereby transformed.
translations.idiomatic: He also recommended the scholars He Ruilin and Yang Shuchun, men of earnest purpose and upright learning; Ruilin received the title of director of study at the Imperial Academy and Shuchun the title of Hanlin awaiting edict, and local scholarly culture was transformed.

sentences.zh: 時詔修頤和園，大澂復言時事艱難，請停止工作。

translations.literal: At the time an edict ordered repairs to the Summer Palace; Dacheng again stated that the times were difficult and requested that the work be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the court ordered repairs to the Summer Palace, Dacheng again argued that times were hard and asked that the work be halted.

sentences.zh: 疏入，留中。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; it was kept at court without action.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and filed without action.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，山、陝大饑，奉命襄辦賑務。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu there was great famine in Shanxi and Shaanxi; he was ordered to assist in relief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1877, when Shanxi and Shaanxi suffered great famine, he was ordered to assist in relief work.

sentences.zh: 躬履災區查勘，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: He personally went into the disaster area to inspect, and saved a great many lives.
translations.idiomatic: He went in person into the stricken regions to inspect conditions and saved a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠、曾國荃、李鴻章等交章論薦。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang, Zeng Guoquan, Li Hongzhang, and others submitted successive memorials recommending him.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang, Zeng Guoquan, Li Hongzhang, and others submitted memorial after memorial recommending him.

sentences.zh: 四年，授河北道。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed to the Hebei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1878 he was appointed intendant of the Hebei circuit.

sentences.zh: 時比歲薦飢，貧民減價鬻田，十不得一。

translations.literal: At the time famine recurred year after year; poor commoners sold land at reduced prices and received less than one-tenth of its value.
translations.idiomatic: Famine had struck year after year, and poor farmers sold land at a fraction of its worth, often receiving less than a tenth of the fair price.

sentences.zh: 巡撫塗宗瀛飭荒歲賤價之田準取贖，然往往為勢家所持，以故失業者眾。

translations.literal: Governor Tu Zongying ordered that land sold cheaply in famine years could be redeemed at the standard rate, but it was often held up by powerful families, and therefore many lost their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Tu Zongying ruled that land sold cheaply in famine years could be redeemed at the standard rate, but powerful families often blocked redemption, leaving many farmers landless.

sentences.zh: 惟大澂能判決如巡撫恉。

translations.literal: Only Dacheng was able to decide cases according to the governor's directive.
translations.idiomatic: Only Dacheng enforced the governor's ruling as written.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔給三品卿銜，隨吉林將軍銘​​安辦理西北邊防。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was granted third-rank vice-minister title and followed Jilin General Ming'an in managing northwest frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In 1880 he was granted third-rank vice-minister title and accompanied Jilin General Ming'an in managing northwest frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 大澂週曆要隘，始知琿春黑頂子地久為俄人侵占。

translations.literal: Dacheng toured the strategic passes in circuit and first learned that the Hunchun-Heidingzi lands had long been occupied by Russians.
translations.idiomatic: Touring the strategic passes, Dacheng discovered for the first time that the Hunchun-Heidingzi region had long been occupied by Russia.

sentences.zh: 因請頒舊界圖，將定期與俄官抗議，未得旨。

translations.literal: He therefore requested issuance of the old boundary maps and planned to set a date to protest with Russian officials, but received no imperial response.
translations.idiomatic: He petitioned for the old boundary maps and planned to lodge a formal protest with Russian officials, but received no imperial response.

sentences.zh: 時有韓效忠者，登州人，傭於復州侯氏。

translations.literal: At the time there was a man named Han Xiaozhong, a native of Dengzhou, who had been hired by the Hou clan of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was a man named Han Xiaozhong from Dengzhou who had worked as a hired hand for the Hou family of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 負博進，遁往吉林夾皮溝。

translations.literal: He owed gambling debts and fled to Jiapigou in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Deep in gambling debt, he fled to Jiapigou in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 地產金，在寧古塔、三姓東，萬山環繞，廣袤七八百里。

translations.literal: The place produced gold; it lay east of Ningguta and Sansing, encircled by myriad mountains, seven or eight hundred li in breadth.
translations.idiomatic: The place was rich in gold, lying east of Ningguta and Sansing, ringed by mountains and stretching seven or eight hundred li across.

sentences.zh: 流冗嘯聚其中，亡慮四五萬，咸受效忠約束。

translations.literal: Vagrant riffraff gathered there in bands, numbering on the order of forty or fifty thousand, all subject to Xiaozhong's discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Vagrant laborers gathered there in bands, perhaps forty or fifty thousand in all, all under Xiaozhong's rule.

sentences.zh: 效忠嚴而不擾，眾服其公允，屢抗大軍不出。

translations.literal: Xiaozhong was strict without being oppressive; the masses respected his fairness, and he repeatedly resisted imperial armies without coming out.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozhong ruled firmly but fairly, and his followers respected his justice; he repeatedly held off imperial troops without surrendering.

sentences.zh: 大澂單騎抵其巢，留宿三日，勸效忠出，效忠猶豫，意難之。

translations.literal: Dacheng rode alone to his lair, stayed three nights, and urged Xiaozhong to come out; Xiaozhong hesitated and found it hard to agree.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng rode alone to the stronghold, stayed three nights, and urged Xiaozhong to surrender; Xiaozhong hesitated, torn by the difficulty of the choice.

sentences.zh: 大澂曰：「我不疑若，若乃疑我耶？

translations.literal: Dacheng said: "I do not doubt you—do you doubt me?
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng said, "I do not doubt you—do you doubt me?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「非敢疑公。

translations.literal: " He replied: "I would not dare doubt Your Excellency.
translations.idiomatic: " He replied, "I would not dare doubt you, sir.

sentences.zh: 某負罪久，萬一主兵者執前事為罪。

translations.literal: I have long borne guilt; if by chance the military commander should treat my past deeds as crimes.
translations.idiomatic: I have been guilty a long time; if the commander should treat my past deeds as crimes,

sentences.zh: 某死不恨，辜公意奈何？

translations.literal: I would not regret death, but how could I fail Your Excellency's intent?
translations.idiomatic: my death would not trouble me, but how could I fail your trust?"

sentences.zh: 」大澂挺以自任，遂與效忠出，奏給五品頂戴，子七品，孫登舉有平寇功，授參將。

translations.literal: " Dacheng pledged to take responsibility himself; thereupon he came out with Xiaozhong, and a memorial granted Xiaozhong a fifth-rank cap button, his son seventh rank, and his grandson Dengju, who had merit in pacifying bandits, appointment as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: " Dacheng pledged to answer for him personally; Xiaozhong then came out with him, and the court granted Xiaozhong a fifth-rank cap button, his son seventh rank, and his grandson Dengju, who had helped pacify the bandits, appointment as colonel.

sentences.zh: 七年，授太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881 he was appointed vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 法越事起，會辦北洋軍務，駐防樂亭、昌黎。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, he was assigned to assist in Beiyang military affairs and garrisoned Leting and Changli.
translations.idiomatic: When the Franco-Vietnamese conflict broke out, he was assigned to assist in Beiyang military affairs and garrisoned Leting and Changli.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to vice censor-in-chief of the left.
translations.idiomatic: In 1884 he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief of the left.

sentences.zh: 俄，命使朝鮮，定其內亂，鹽運使續昌副之。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was ordered as envoy to Korea to settle its internal disorder; Salt Transport Commissioner Xu Chang served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was dispatched as envoy to Korea to settle its internal disorder, with Salt Transport Commissioner Xu Chang as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 至則日本使​​臣井上馨避不肯見，而挾朝鮮左議政金宏集於議政院，索償兵費三十萬。

translations.literal: Upon arrival the Japanese minister Inoue Kaoru avoided him and refused to meet, but seized Korean Left State Councillor Kim Hong-jip at the State Council and demanded three hundred thousand in military indemnity.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he found the Japanese minister Inoue Kaoru avoiding him and refusing an audience, while holding Korea's Left State Councillor Kim Hong-jip at the State Council and demanding three hundred thousand taels in military indemnity.

sentences.zh: 大澂謂續昌曰：「是蔑我也！

translations.literal: Dacheng said to Xu Chang: "This is contempt for me!"
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng said to Xu Chang, "This is an insult to me!"

sentences.zh: 」立率兵至議政院，排闥入，責數宏集：「柄國敗壞國事。

translations.literal: " He immediately led troops to the State Council, pushed open the doors and entered, and rebuked Kim Hong-jip: "You hold power and have ruined the state's affairs."
translations.idiomatic: " He immediately led troops to the State Council, pushed open the doors, and rebuked Kim Hong-jip: "You hold power and have ruined the country's affairs."

sentences.zh: 今定約稍不慎，便滋異日紛，非所以靖國也。

translations.literal: If the agreement now made is the least bit careless, it will breed future troubles; this is not the way to settle the state.
translations.idiomatic: If the agreement you make now is the least bit careless, it will breed trouble for years to come; that is no way to restore order to the country."

sentences.zh: 」宏集唯唯，井上馨亦氣懾，減索兵費十一萬而去。

translations.literal: " Kim Hong-jip assented repeatedly; Inoue Kaoru also lost his nerve, reduced the military indemnity demand to one hundred ten thousand, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: " Kim Hong-jip assented meekly; Inoue Kaoru also lost his nerve, cut the indemnity demand to one hundred ten thousand taels, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔赴吉林，會同副都統伊克唐阿與俄使勘侵界，即所侵琿春黑頂子地也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was ordered to go to Jilin, and together with Vice Commander-in-Chief Yiketang'a and the Russian envoy surveyed the encroached boundary—the very Hunchun-Heidingzi lands that had been seized.
translations.idiomatic: In 1885 he was ordered to Jilin, where together with Vice Commander-in-Chief Yiketang'a and the Russian envoy he surveyed the encroached border—the very Hunchun-Heidingzi territory Russia had seized.

sentences.zh: 遂援咸豐十一年舊界圖立碑五座，建銅柱，自篆銘曰：「疆域有表國有維，此柱可立不可移。

translations.literal: Thereupon relying on the old boundary maps of the eleventh year of Xianfeng he erected five boundary steles and built bronze pillars, personally carving the inscription: "Boundaries have their markers and the state has its pillars; these pillars may be erected but must not be moved."
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the boundary maps of 1861, he erected five boundary steles and bronze pillars, personally inscribing them: "Boundaries have their markers and the state has its pillars; these pillars may stand but must never be moved."

sentences.zh: 」於是侵界復歸中國，而船之出入圖們江者亦卒以通航無阻。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the encroached territory was restored to China, and vessels entering and leaving the Tumen River were ultimately able to pass without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: " The encroached territory was restored to China, and vessels passing in and out of the Tumen River were at last able to navigate without hindrance.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1886 he was promoted to governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 葡萄牙侵界至澳門香山。

translations.literal: Portugal encroached on the boundary as far as Xiangshan near Macau.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal had encroached on Chinese territory as far as Xiangshan near Macau.

sentences.zh: 總署與立約通商，畫澳門歸葡轄。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen concluded a treaty for trade and drew Macau under Portuguese jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen negotiated a trade treaty that placed Macau under Portuguese jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 大澂持不可，條上駁議，不報。

translations.literal: Dacheng held this unacceptable and submitted itemized objections; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng objected and submitted a detailed rebuttal, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 十四年，鄭州河再決，上震怒，褫河督李鶴年職，以大澂代之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Zhengzhou river broke again; the emperor was greatly angered, stripped River Director Li Henian of office, and replaced him with Dacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In 1888 the Zhengzhou embankment failed again; the emperor was furious, dismissed River Director Li Henian, and replaced him with Dacheng.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，河工合龍，大澂力居多。

translations.literal: That winter the river works were joined; Dacheng's effort counted for the greater part.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the breach was closed, and Dacheng's effort accounted for most of the success.

sentences.zh: 大澂盛負時譽，會海軍議起，以醇親王奕枻為總理。

translations.literal: Dacheng enjoyed great contemporary reputation; when naval affairs were under discussion, Prince Chun Yixuan was made director.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng enjoyed great renown at court; when naval affairs came under discussion, Prince Chun (Yixuan) was appointed to direct them.

sentences.zh: 大澂素與王善，治河功成，實授河道總督，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: Dacheng had long been on good terms with the prince; when river work was successfully completed he was formally appointed director-general of river conservancy and granted the first-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng had long been on good terms with the prince; when the river work succeeded he received formal appointment as director-general of river conservancy and the first-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 大澂遂疏請尊崇醇親王稱號禮節。

translations.literal: Dacheng thereupon memorialized requesting enhanced titles and ceremonial honors for Prince Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng then memorialized requesting enhanced titles and ceremonial honors for Prince Chun.

sentences.zh: 疏入，孝欽顯皇后震怒，出醇親王元年所上預杜妄論疏頒示天下。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, Empress Dowager Cixi was greatly angered and issued for publication throughout the realm the memorial Prince Chun had submitted in the first year of his reign to forestall reckless talk.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, Empress Dowager Cixi was furious and ordered published throughout the empire the memorial Prince Chun had submitted in the first year of his son's reign to forestall reckless speculation.

sentences.zh: 大澂幾得嚴譴，以母喪歸，乃已。

translations.literal: Dacheng nearly received severe punishment; he returned home on his mother's mourning, and only then did it end.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng narrowly escaped severe punishment; he went home to mourn his mother, and the affair ended there.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1892 he was appointed governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮東學黨之亂也，日本與中國開釁，朝議皆主戰。

translations.literal: When the Donghak rebellion broke out in Korea, Japan and China opened hostilities; court opinion overwhelmingly favored war.
translations.idiomatic: During the Donghak rebellion in Korea, war broke out between Japan and China, and the court overwhelmingly favored fighting.

sentences.zh: 大澂因自請率湘軍赴前敵，優詔允之。

translations.literal: Dacheng therefore volunteered to lead Hunan troops to the front; an edict graciously approved.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng volunteered to lead Hunan troops to the front, and the court graciously approved.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，出關會諸軍規复海城，而日本由間道取牛莊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he left the pass to join the armies in planning to recover Haicheng, while Japan took Niuzhuang by a bypath.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he marched beyond the pass to join allied forces in a planned recovery of Haicheng, while Japanese troops seized Niuzhuang by a back route.

sentences.zh: 魏光燾往禦，戰不利。

translations.literal: Wei Guangtao went to resist; the battle went badly.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guangtao moved to intercept them and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 李光久馳救之，亦敗，僅以數騎免。

translations.literal: Li Guangjiu rushed to rescue but was also defeated, escaping with only a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangjiu galloped to the rescue but was beaten as well, escaping with only a handful of horsemen.

sentences.zh: 大澂憤湘軍盡覆，拔劍欲自裁，王同愈在側，格阻之，同愈以編修參大澂軍事也。

translations.literal: Dacheng, enraged that the Hunan army was wholly destroyed, drew his sword intending suicide; Wang Tongyu was at his side and blocked him; Tongyu, as a compiler, was attached to Dacheng's military staff.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged that the Hunan army had been wiped out, Dacheng drew his sword to kill himself; Wang Tongyu, a compiler on his staff, seized his arm and stopped him.

sentences.zh: 光燾請申軍法，大澂歎曰：「餘實不能軍，當自請嚴議。

translations.literal: Guangtao requested application of military law; Dacheng sighed and said: "I truly cannot command armies; I ought to request severe punishment myself."
translations.idiomatic: Guangtao asked that military law be enforced; Dacheng sighed and said, "I truly cannot command an army—I should request the severest censure myself."

sentences.zh: 」退入關，奉革職留任之旨。

translations.literal: " He withdrew inside the pass and received an order of dismissal from office but retention of duties.
translations.idiomatic: " He withdrew beyond the pass and received orders to strip his rank while keeping him at his post.

sentences.zh: 乃還湖南，尋命開缺。

translations.literal: He then returned to Hunan; soon he was ordered to vacate his post.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Hunan and was soon ordered to vacate his post.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，复降旨革職永不敘用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year an edict again ordered dismissal from office with permanent exclusion from appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 a further edict dismissed him permanently from office.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died, aged sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1902 at the age of sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 大澂善篆籀，罷官後，貧甚，售書畫、古銅器自給。

translations.literal: Dacheng was skilled in seal and bronze script; after leaving office he was very poor and supported himself by selling calligraphy, paintings, and ancient bronzes.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng was a master of seal and bronze script; after he left office he lived in great poverty and sold paintings, calligraphy, and antiquities to get by.

sentences.zh: 著有古籀補、古玉圖考、權衡度量考、恆軒古金錄、齋詩文集。

translations.literal: His works include Supplement to Ancient Seal Script, Inquiry into Ancient Jades, Inquiry into Weights and Measures, Hengxuan Record of Ancient Bronzes, and collected poems and prose of his studio.
translations.idiomatic: His published works include Supplement to Ancient Seal Script, Inquiry into Ancient Jades, Inquiry into Weights and Measures, Hengxuan Record of Ancient Bronzes, and collected poems and essays.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：河患日棘，而河臣但歲慶安瀾，即為奇績，久未聞統全局而防永患，求治難矣。

translations.literal: Commentary says: River disasters grow daily more pressing, yet river officials merely celebrate each year's calm waters as a marvel; for long one has not heard of governing the whole situation to guard against perpetual disaster—seeking a cure is hard indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary observes: Yellow River crises grow worse each year, yet river officials treat every season without a breach as a marvel. For years no one has coordinated the whole system to prevent lasting disaster; a real cure seems far away.

sentences.zh: 鶴年以善治河稱，文彬論治河改運口，复淮流，亦頗有識。

translations.literal: Henian was famed for skill in governing the river; Wen Bin's discussions on changing transport mouths and restoring the Huai current also showed considerable insight.
translations.idiomatic: Henian was renowned for river management; Wen Bin's proposals to relocate transport mouths and restore the Huai also showed real vision.

sentences.zh: 道鎔剔河工積弊，務節減，振禕督工嚴，盡革中飽，尤以勤廉者，皆足收一時之效，然徒治標，非治本計也。

translations.literal: Daorong eliminated long-standing abuses in river works and strove to economize; Zhenyi supervised works strictly and thoroughly reformed embezzlement; especially with diligence and integrity they all could secure temporary effects, yet this was only treating symptoms, not a plan to cure the root.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong rooted out entrenched abuses and cut costs; Zhenyi supervised works rigorously and stamped out graft. Their diligence and integrity achieved real short-term gains, yet these were palliatives, not a cure for the underlying disease.

sentences.zh: 大澂治河有名，而好言兵，才氣自喜，卒以虛憍敗，惜哉！

translations.literal: Dacheng was famous for governing the river, yet loved to speak of military affairs and took pride in his talent; in the end he failed through empty arrogance—alas!
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng won fame for river work yet loved to talk of war and took pride in his own brilliance; in the end empty arrogance ruined him—a pity indeed!
